summary: The Row/Tx-bound shared helpers for the work-store adapters: task-summary shaping from a row, the coding_events insert (both sequence forms), the pinned-recipe document lookup, and ControlOutcome assembly. All functions are pub(crate).
responsibilities: summary shapes one coding_tasks row into TaskSummary exactly as Python _summary: task_id from column id, correlation_id, project_alias, base_revision, mode, agent_profile, recipe_digest, status, revision, created_at via format_ts; title included when the column exists and is non-null; workflow_required / workflow_phase included when the column exists (try_get).

insert_event merges actor (and cause when present) into the payload object - they overwrite same-named payload keys - then inserts into forge_agent.coding_events: with first=true the explicit sequence 1 form, otherwise the SELECT coalesce(max(sequence),0)+1 form. Both forms are pinned in the pattern.

outcome_for builds a ControlOutcome after a control operation: it re-reads the task row (the tasks summary SELECT pinned in work_read_get's pattern, by owner/project/id) and shapes summary(row); receipt_id is the event_id of the task's event whose payload revision equals receipt_revision (SELECT event_id FROM forge_agent.coding_events WHERE owner/project/task AND payload->>'revision' = $4::text ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1), falling back to the task's latest event_id when no revision matches.

pinned_recipe_for finds the recipe document for a digest among the project's existing tasks: SELECT pinned_recipe FROM forge_agent.coding_tasks WHERE owner_id=$1 AND project_alias=$2 AND recipe_digest=$3 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1. The Rust requests carry recipes resolved to digests only (no document), so control operations that must re-pin a recipe reuse the document already pinned for that digest; a digest with no pin anywhere is the caller's rejected(503, unavailable) case.

outcome_for's summary SELECT is the task summary column set: SELECT id, correlation_id, project_alias, base_revision, mode, agent_profile, recipe_digest, status, revision, created_at, title, workflow_required FROM forge_agent.coding_tasks WHERE owner_id=$1 AND project_alias=$2 AND id=$3, plus workflow_phase via a LEFT JOIN on coding_workflows when needed - shape it with summary(row) from a row that also selects w.phase AS workflow_phase (LEFT JOIN forge_agent.coding_workflows w ON (w.owner_id, w.project_alias, w.workflow_id) = (t.owner_id, t.project_alias, t.workflow_id) with the task table aliased t).
invariants: insert_event's merged payload always carries actor; cause is present only when the caller passes one (negative kinds require it - the caller validates via forge_work::Cause::allowed_for).
Every helper is pub(crate); tokio_postgres::Row never appears in a public signature.
